Title: What is NLP? The map of this series
Concepts covered: History in four eras: rules, statistics, neural nets, LLMs; core tasks (classification, tagging, parsing, translation, generation); why language is hard (ambiguity, context, world knowledge); how the 100 videos fit together
Code / hands-on (what the viewer builds): Run a tiny rule-based chatbot (ELIZA-style) and then a small open LLM on the same prompts to feel the gap
Key references: Jurafsky & Martin, Speech and Language Processing 3rd ed. (SLP3) ch.1; Weizenbaum 1966 ELIZA

Title: Setting up: Python, Jupyter, Colab, NumPy, PyTorch
Concepts covered: Virtual envs; notebooks vs scripts; Colab free GPU; GPU vs CPU; installing PyTorch and Hugging Face; reproducibility and seeds

Key references: PyTorch install docs; Colab docs

Title: Text as data: Unicode, UTF-8, bytes and normalization

Key references: SLP3 ch.2
